summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of VARA app after major feature additions (new bonus economics $1 @5/15/25.., referral system 10% capped $10, calculator page, referrals page, trust feed, public stats endpoints). 18/18 backend pytest tests pass. All 7 frontend flows pass with screenshot verification.
critical_code_review_comments: Bonus math in routes/tasks.py:compute_bonuses_earned is clean and correct: returns 0 below 5, then 1 + (n-5)//10 which yields bonuses at 5,15,25,35.

Referral cap enforcement in pay_referrer is correct: uses referrer_earnings_paid field tracking + cap_remaining check before each payout. Verified empirically by completing all available tasks (delta stayed <=$10).
Referral payout is triggered on TOTAL earned (task reward + bonus) which correctly pays referrer 10% of the $1 bonus too (verified: 5 tasks -> $1.50 earned -> $0.15 referral).
Referral code generation uses secrets.choice on a legible alphabet with collision check loop - solid.
Validate endpoint (/api/referrals/validate/{code}) is case-insensitive (upper-casing in both register and validate) - good UX.
Invalid referral code on signup is silently accepted (user gets created without referrer) - matches spec for better UX.
Login + register + refresh all return access_token/refresh_token in body AND set httpOnly cookies - correctly supports both mobile (body tokens) and web (cookie) clients.
Email masking in referrals/me and stats/recent-withdrawals is consistent (first 2 chars + ***@domain).
Public endpoints /api/stats/total-paid-out and /api/stats/recent-withdrawals correctly require no auth and return masked data.
MINOR: routes/stats.py recent_withdrawals does N+1 user lookup (one per withdrawal) - fine at current scale, consider $lookup aggregation when volume grows.
MINOR: TOTAL_PAID_OUT_BASE env var supported but defaults to 0, so early launch shows real numbers only. Intentional per code comment.
MINOR: UserResponse model unused in register/login endpoints (they return raw dicts). Not a bug but inconsistency.

MINOR: Dashboard shows 'Bonuses: 0' for admin despite having 8 tasks completed because admin was seeded before bonuses_earned field existed - only relevant for pre-existing admin, new users correctly track from 0. Not a bug.
